body:
I'm able to reproduce this issue.

If I go into "Project Settings" and use the file browser to set the OpenXR action map path, it'll trigger a UID to be saved in project settings, and then attempting to save the OpenXR action map will fail. I'm only setting it back it `res://openxr_action_map.tres` which is the default, so theoretically, it shouldn't need to save it, which is probably a bug on its own, but we do need to support setting this to an arbitrary resource which should (I think) be saved as a UID.

I just posted PR https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105624, which fixes the issue in my testing, but I don't know if this is the right way to fix this (because I'm not sure the proper way to handle UIDs in editor code).
